title: Run to sanctuary before fear hardens
summary: This meets the moment when the inner thieves are already upon you and composure is gone. The line does not pretend strength; it cries to the Father and takes shelter.
takeaway: Take sanctuary before panic organizes you.
lifeApplication: When the body goes cold or the stomach drops, say the line before inventing your defense. Let the cry for shelter come earlier than the panic plan.

source.shortMeaning: Fear is met by sanctuary, not by pretending self-sufficiency.
source.lifeApplication: In the first surge of fear, ask for shelter before strategy takes over.

evidence.coreClaim: Fear is met by sanctuary, not by pretending self-sufficiency.
evidence.turn: Call for shelter before fear becomes your only voice.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the body goes cold or the stomach drops, say the line before inventing your defense. Let the cry for shelter come earlier than the panic plan.
